eventTriggerInterpretation: The state ranker is not yet a sufficiently specific standalone trigger. Its frozen training-recall threshold passed 78.95% of assessment teacher states, but only 31.58% of episodes first crossed at the final selected state; the upper-quarter first crossings were materially premature. A full transition/cross-sectional event rule must be validated before prospective use.
humanReadableFingerprint: 2CQ usually chooses a newly launched, currently moving mint, then enters immediately after a compact externally driven burst: strong positive 250ms flow and price response, several consecutive buys, and less single-buyer concentration. Cross-mint choice is mostly lifecycle/recency; exact within-mint timing depends more on the short flow transition.
